conviction_note: Q3 itself should be strong (summer peak of the 66 MEUR data-centre earthworks plus KSBR's first consolidated quarter) but the line the stock trades on is the 2026 guide: consensus already sits near the top of 70-95 MEUR (Inderes 90.5), there was no positive profit warning this October as there was in 2025, and the Muhos data-centre halt ordered on 6 Oct threatens Q4. So any narrowing is more likely to land at or below consensus than above it. That gives a mild negative lean (p_up 45) on a large expected absolute move (7.5%). The findings sum to -0.8, close to the scaled -0.75, so the two measurements agree.

findings.finding: The Lupa- ja valvontavirasto ordered Google's Tuike Finland on 6 Oct 2026 to halt preparatory earthworks at the Muhos and Kajaani data-centre sites until the EIA is complete, expected around end-2026. That scope matches GRK's 66 MEUR data-centre contract (site preparatory work, earthmoving, excavation; June to December 2026; local press placed GRK at Muhos). So an estimated 15-25 MEUR of Q4 revenue and some of the high-margin Q4 profit likely slips into 2027, and the release is the first place GRK can quantify it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance lines move GRK hard: the FY25 release with a weak 2026 first guide fell 9.2% (2026-02-12); positive profit warnings rose 13.1% (2025-06-18) and 5.3% (2025-10-17). The day after the halt order the stock fell 4.17% (2026-10-07).
findings.original_quote: Lupa- ja valvontavirasto (LVV) kehotti Googlea keskeyttämään Muhoksen ja Kajaanin datakeskusten valmistelutyöt tiistaina 6. lokakuuta. [The permit and supervision agency asked Google on Tuesday 6 October to halt preparatory works at the Muhos and Kajaani data centres.] / Inderes 21.10: 'mikäli keskeytys koskee yhtiön töitä, arvioimme sen siirtävän liikevaihtoa neljänneltä kvartaalilta ensi vuodelle' [if the halt covers the company's work, we estimate it shifts revenue from Q4 to next year]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: -4.17% on 7 Oct and -4.7% over 20 days. But GRK has never named the customer or site, and Inderes still models 2026 adj EBIT at 90.5, near the top of the range, and has not cut for it. If the halt were fully priced, consensus 2026e would sit below the 82.5 midpoint rather than at 90.5.
findings.independence: GRK's own release on the 66 MEUR contract (scope and June-December schedule): https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bfb2a958d66bbe3eb41b905d4f4287c2c&lang=en&src=listed ; Kaleva 12.10.2026, Google confirms the halt and that it is unclear when work can resume: https://www.kaleva.fi/google-vastasi-viranomaiselle-tyomailla-saatetaan/13706132

findings.finding: GRK filed no positive profit warning before this Q3, although it filed two in 2025 (18 Jun and 17 Oct, the latter ten days before the Q3'25 print). Consensus 2026 adj EBIT (~90) already sits in the top fifth of the 70-95 range, so a narrowed range can add at most ~5 MEUR above consensus but could set a midpoint well below it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 17 Oct 2025 positive warning rose 5.3%, and the Q3'25 print ten days later fell 4.34% once the upgrade was already out. The weak 2026 first guide fell 9.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference from an absence, and the market may read it the same way. But the Inderes preview frames a narrowing as neutral-to-positive ('ennusteet ovat haarukoiden yläpäässä' [forecasts are at the top end of the ranges]) and does not discuss the cap. With the stock at 25 against Inderes' 23 target, valuation leaves no room for an in-line guide.

findings.finding: Q3 is the quarter that carried the bulk of the high-margin 66 MEUR data-centre earthworks (June-December schedule, full summer pace before the October halt). GRK said data-centre projects 'significantly' lifted Q2 revenue and profit, and Q3 adds KSBR's first consolidated quarter and the new KSBR data-centre contract started in September. So Q3 adj EBIT can clear the 33.6 MEUR consensus, as Q2 cleared Inderes' 15.1 with 24.4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 large margin beat: +8.04% on the day (2026-07-28) and +3.38% the next. Q1'26 margin beat: +2.02% and +10.65% the next day. Q3'25 after a pre-release: -4.34%.
findings.original_quote: Lisäksi yhtiö nosti esiin datakeskushankkeet, joilla oli merkittävä vaikutus neljänneksen liikevaihtoon ja tulokseen. [The company also highlighted data-centre projects, which had a significant impact on the quarter's revenue and result.]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: consensus already expects +44% adj EBIT YoY at a 10.3% margin. The residual is that the 3-analyst consensus sits below Inderes' 35.0, and Inderes notes Q2 was also helped by project-risk releases that may not repeat. This finding is therefore small and nets that against the data-centre peak.
